about: Card-face bodies that a strict dialect-v2 reader (.winkmd import) must accept or reject. Companion to wink-spec-markdown-format.md. The app's WinkMarkdownFileTests and the Skill's validator tests both read this file; change it here, then rerun both.
wrap: Each body becomes the front of a one-card manuscript: header, body, <!-- back -->, back text. headerless_files are whole manuscripts, read as is; each must parse as one card whose first lines are body text, not a header.
